maker.name: Kailh
maker.about: Kailh is the switch brand of Dongguan City Kaihua Electronics Co., Ltd., a Chinese maker of keyboard, mouse and micro switches founded in 1990. Its keyboard range spans MX-style Box, Speed and Pro switches, Choc low-profile switches and magnetic switches.

sources.title: Kailh: home page (Dongguan City Kaihua Electronics)

reviews.verdict: Covers the China Style Box set; the 95 g Ancient Grey linear is the one the reviewer thinks deserves more attention.
ThereminGoat's measured curve reads about 121 gf near bottom-out over 3.9 mm of measured travel.
